message.content: {"answer": "C", "option_text": "Pronounced vessels in the upper and ventral lung areas with hyperdense material in the pulmonary arteries; suggestive of cement embolism due to vertebroplasty.", "reason": "The provided CT images (figures 4a/4b) definitively show hyperdense, radiopaque material within the pulmonary arteries, which is pathognomonic for polymethylmethacrylate (cement) embolism following vertebroplasty.
